skills.name: Solus
skills.description:
Lose oneself to battle with an intense, combat-focused will.
If the combat state is maintained for a certain period of time, the damage increases.

skills.name: Contact Caravan
skills.description:
A goodbye gift from the Caravan that uses specialized radio equipment to communicate. The buff you receive will differ depending on who you contact. Not affected by buff duration bonuses or cooldown resets.
Right-click to lock message pop-up.

skills.name: Contact Caravan (Zippy)
skills.description: You contacted Zippy! Your damage and EXP gain increases, and your skill cooldown decreases rapidly.

skills.name: Contact Caravan (Ferret)
skills.description: You contacted Ferret! Your skill cooldown decreases rapidly.

skills.name: Contact Caravan (Salvo)
skills.description: You contacted Salvo! Damage increased.

skills.name: Innate Gift
skills.description:
Receive the blessing of the desert and recover HP and MP for a short period when attacking. Permanently increases Damage. Not affected by effects which reset cooldowns, reduce cooldown, or increase buff durations.

Level 3: Also increases Damage for Khali.

skills.name: Void Rush
skills.description:
[Void]
Move quickly in one direction to leave only an afterimage. You can move left or right by also pressing the relevant arrow key. In Stationary mode, if terrain would block your movement, you do not move. Additionally, the skill can be used in directions you cannot move to. Not affected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Insanity I
skills.description: A blade is added to the afterimage to enhance Void Rush. Void Rush is enhanced to be used in 8 directions and deal damage to enemies along the movement path. You enter Dark Sight temporarily and remain aloft for a short period when you stop moving. It can be used while using Arts or Hex-type skills, and you can stop immediately by pressing jump. In Stationary mode, if terrain would block your movement, you do not move. Additionally, the skill can be used in directions you cannot move to. Void Rush is unaffected by attack reflection or cooldown resets.

skills.name: Resonate
skills.description: Manifests chakri summoned by a strong magic power to be moved freely. Using Hex-type skills manifest chakri within a certain range with Resonate, and the manifested Resonate targets and attacks enemy around the manifestation point. Targets the boss with the highest HP first, and unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Insanity II
skills.description: Further enhances Void Rush with a more powerful afterimage. Increases the attack range of Void Rush when used consecutively, and can be linked with Hex-type skills. However, it can be used up to 2 times in mid-air in a direction, including up, regardless of cooldown reset. When using skills other than Spark or Hex-type skills, the consecutive usage state is canceled. Void Rush can be used again during Void Rush movement to instantly start the next movement. In Stationary mode, if terrain would block your movement, you do not move. Additionally, the skill can be used in directions you cannot move to. Void Rush is unaffected by attack reflection or cooldown resets. Overwrites the effect of Insanity I.

When the thrown chakram reaches the max distance, it attacks by spinning for a short period then returns to the character's location while attacking enemies on its path. skills.name: Void Blitz

While active, temporarily enter the Dark Sight state. Not affected by cooldown reset. With Action Customization enabled, you can activate Void Blitz by using Void Rush without the arrow keys.

skills.name: Death Blossom
skills.description: A rose of despair made of sand blooms. The dark rose attacks surrounding enemies for a certain period of time and has a chance of creating summoned chakri in the location of the attack. Additional summoned chakri are created if the total target attacked is lower than the max. Unaffected by attack reflection. Resummon the rose by holding the down arrow key and the skill key while it is blooming.

skills.name: HEXA Void Rush
skills.description:
[Void]
Move quickly in one direction, leaving only an afterimage. Use the arrow keys to aim in one of the cardinal or ordinal directions. Dashing through enemies deals damage, and this skill can be used consecutively. However, you can dash upwards 2 times in midair regardless of Cooldown reset. The skill cannot be used consecutively upon using non-Spark or Hex type skills. Casting Void Rush during another Void Rush will cancel the first use and move you in the new direction. You temporarily enter the Dark Sight state and remain aloft for a short period when you stop moving. This skill can be used while using Arts or Hex-type skills, and you can stop immediately by pressing jump. In Stationary mode, if terrain would block your movement, you do not move. Additionally, the skill can be used in directions you cannot move to. Void Rush is unaffected by attack reflection and cooldown resets.
